title: Hegel
summary: The integrated amplifier used for the documented audio integration.
body:
## Configure the amplifier

Connect and set up the amplifier using its manufacturer instructions. The documented integration is hegel_streaming, exposing a media_player in Home Assistant.

## Verify supported controls

Check playback, track metadata and standby behavior, then map the media player to Ramka. Support for other players depends on meeting the component’s contract.

## Optional power measurement

A mains meter is optional, not required for playback. A model-specific electrical guide is not yet published here; do not infer Shelly compatibility or wiring from this audio example. Electrical installation requires a qualified installer.

## Setup references

- [Hegel Streaming installation and supported models](https://github.com/zerostorypoints/hegel-home-assistant)

These upstream instructions may evolve; the component versions and pinned source above record the DomoSenso scope.
